acceptance.assertion: T059 starts only after T058 is verified and records one exact Grabowski merge commit SHA and tree SHA produced from the verified T057 head. A task file, open pull request, reviewed head, unverified merge or later containing main head is insufficient.

Before every effect, bind fresh break-glass approval and all deployment evidence to the exact T058-recorded merge commit, then read current Grabowski main and CI, deployed runtime identity, active tasks, leases, worktrees, deployment contention, watchdog services and timers, connector snapshot and control-plane poll evidence. Unknown or conflicting state blocks execution.

Deploy exactly the merge commit SHA recorded by verified T058 through the canonical commit-bound path. If Grabowski main has advanced, do not substitute or silently include the later head; deploy the approved revision explicitly or stop if the canonical path cannot do so safely. Do not edit source, replace unrelated host files, stop foreign work or bypass deployment gates.

A controlled, reversible and non-secret stale-poll proof shows that repeated stale evidence reaches the existing failure threshold and bounded restart path without changing restart budget, backoff, jitter or recovery-probe semantics.

Controlled unavailable, missing and timestamp-invalid metric cases remain indeterminate and do not by themselves authorize a restart; concrete local health or readiness failures continue to produce their existing unhealthy reasons.

After deployment and the controlled proof, both watchdog timers are active and waiting with future elapses, service results are read back, any restart count is bounded, and no persistent failure or restart loop remains.
The connector snapshot and control-plane poll freshness renew after recovery, tool inventory remains matched, and at least one live Grabowski tool call succeeds against the deployed revision.

A commit-bound rollback to the immediately previous runtime is available and validated before the first effect; if deployment or proof fails, restore the prior runtime without reverting the independently verified PR #478 timer scheduling unless separately shown faulty.

Deployment identity, preflight, controlled proof, restart decision, timer and service readback, connector freshness, tool readback and rollback sufficiency are recorded as immutable receipts before T059 can become verified.

approval.note: Registration, T057 completion and T058 merge do not authorize deployment or restart. Every live effect requires fresh break-glass approval bound to the exact T058-recorded merge commit, current host state, quiet-window evidence and rollback plan; a later containing main head is not equivalent.

goal: After T058 is verified, deploy only the exact Grabowski merge commit recorded by T058 through the canonical commit-bound path and prove on the live host that repeatedly stale control-plane polls enter the existing bounded restart loop, while unavailable, missing or invalid metrics remain indeterminate and concrete local failures retain precedence. Never substitute a later main head merely because it contains that merge.

does_not_establish: authority to interrupt foreign work or release foreign leases

merge_deploy_review_correction.finding: Implementation, merge and deployment require three separate authority phases; deployment must pin the exact merge revision rather than a later containing main head.

review_correction.finding: Repository implementation and live runtime deployment require separate tasks and approval classes.

rollback.strategy: Redeploy the exact immediately previous commit-bound Grabowski runtime recorded by the T059 preflight, restore only T059-owned runtime artifacts, restart only affected Grabowski units through the canonical path, and verify timers, connector snapshot and live tool readback. Preserve PR #478 calendar timer scheduling unless independently disproved.

title: Deploy and prove exact stale-poll merge revision
